title: Ubinkayu ERP
description: Architected an enterprise production management & PO tracking system (Desktop Electron & Web) deployed across PT Ubinkayu's manufacturing pipeline, processing 200+ Purchase Orders from factory floor to executive leadership.

detail.longDescription:
Architected and deployed a hybrid enterprise production management system (Desktop Electron & Web) to eliminate manual paper logging and digitalize PT Ubinkayu's end-to-end manufacturing operations.

Key Impact & Deliverables:
• Operational Scale: Successfully tracked and managed 200+ Purchase Orders end-to-end from raw timber intake to final dispatch.
• Cross-Tier Adoption: Designed role-tailored interfaces actively utilized daily across the company hierarchy—from executive leadership (sales insights, financial overview) and production managers (scheduling, stock monitoring) down to factory-floor operators (real-time photo verification of progress).
• Operational Transparency: Replaced fragmented paper trails with an automated single source of truth, drastically cutting status reconciliation delays and production visibility bottlenecks.
• Smart Analytics & AI: Integrated Google Sheets API data sync for live analytics and embedded an AI business assistant to query production metrics on demand.

title: Dog Emotion Recognition System
description: Engineered an intelligent canine behavioral recognition and care recommendation system, combining fine-tuned YOLO11 computer vision with a high-performance cross-platform Flutter mobile client.

detail.longDescription: Designed and developed an end-to-end intelligent dog care recommendation system focused on behavioral and emotional state detection. Fine-tuned a state-of-the-art YOLO11 computer vision architecture in Python, optimizing detection accuracy across diverse lighting conditions and canine breeds. Built a responsive cross-platform Flutter mobile client featuring real-time camera inference, personalized pet behavioral insights, and contextual care guidelines based on classified emotional states.

title: GreenThumb
description: Engineered a native multi-platform botanical cataloging and identification application for iOS and macOS using Swift and SwiftUI, featuring modular view architectures and responsive local persistence.

detail.longDescription: Engineered a native multi-platform botanical cataloging application designed for the Apple ecosystem (iOS & macOS) using Swift and SwiftUI. Implemented modular navigation flows, adaptive master-detail view hierarchies across phone and desktop form factors, and reactive state management for adding, categorizing, and monitoring personal plant collections.

title: BikeFlow
description: Developed a predictive urban mobility analytics platform leveraging time-series machine learning (SARIMAX) to forecast municipal bike-sharing demand against seasonal and meteorological variables.

detail.longDescription: Developed an end-to-end predictive web platform forecasting daily urban bike-sharing utilization. Engineered time-series econometric models (SARIMAX) in Python to capture seasonal trends and environmental variance, and connected the analytical pipeline to a responsive full-stack web dashboard for visual scenario forecasting.

title: YuccaGPT
description: Architected an interactive voice-enabled information portal integrating Python, Google Cloud Text-to-Speech (TTS), and a modern React frontend for real-time conversational responses.

detail.longDescription: Architected an interactive voice-enabled information portal designed to streamline campus inquiries. Built backend audio synthesis microservices in Python leveraging Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, paired with an interactive, accessible React web frontend delivering fluid audio playback and instant contextual queries.

title: Mulia Lestari Perkasa (MLP)
description: Architected a full-stack B2B digital catalog and customer inquiry platform for a leading ceramic supplier in East Kalimantan, transitioning physical inventory to an interactive web portal.

detail.longDescription: Architected a full-stack digital catalog and customer inquiry portal for Mulia Lestari Perkasa, a major ceramic and building materials distributor in Balikpapan. Engineered robust relational database schemas in MySQL, implemented secure authentication and administrative CRUD interfaces for multi-category catalog management, and enabled digital product discovery for wholesale and retail clients.

title: EduLiving
description: Built an interactive gamified educational platform for zoological park visitors, featuring dynamic trivia challenges, digital collectible rewards, and real-time score tracking.

detail.longDescription: Designed and developed an interactive gamified educational web experience deployed for zoological park visitors during a 48-hour rapid prototyping hackathon. Engineered accessible quiz interfaces, dynamic state handling for collectible animal rewards, and integrated backend score persistence.

title: DigPro
description: Developed an MVP digital marketplace connecting local SMEs with verified content creators, featuring automated onboarding workflows, subscription pipelines, and lead tracking.

detail.longDescription: Developed an MVP marketplace platform designed to bridge commercial matchmaking between SMEs and regional digital creators. Designed relational database architectures to handle service listings, user onboarding, and lead conversions, alongside custom administrative tracking metrics.

title: De Sauge
description: Engineered a bespoke e-commerce storefront for an artisanal food brand, implementing responsive product showcases, interactive cart management, and seamless customer order workflows.

detail.longDescription: Engineered a responsive e-commerce web platform for an artisanal food producer. Customized client-side state architectures for cart interactions, developed interactive product detail showcases, streamlined direct ordering pathways, and implemented mobile-first responsive design standards.
